title: 1985 AHSME Problem 9
statement: The odd positive integers, \(1,\) \(3,\) \(5,\) \(7,\) \(\ldots,\) are arranged in five columns continuing with the pattern shown. Counting from the left, the column in which \(1985\) appears is the \[ \begin{array}{ccccc} &1&3&5&7\\ 15&13&11&9&\\ &17&19&21&23\\ 31&29&27&25&\\ &33&35&37&39\\ 47&45&43&41&\\ &49&51&53&55 \end{array} \]

solutions.text:
The last number in each right-to-left row is \(16k-1,\) and the next row begins with \(16k+1\) in the second column. Since \(1985=16\cdot124+1,\) it begins such a row and lies in the second column.

Thus the correct answer is B.
hints: Look at the entries that begin each left-to-right row
